root_cause.text: The RFCOMM MCC handlers (rfcomm_recv_pn, rfcomm_recv_rpn, rfcomm_recv_rls, rfcomm_recv_msc, and rfcomm_recv_mcc) directly cast skb->data to protocol-specific structs without first validating that the skb contains enough data, allowing a malicious remote device to send truncated frames and cause out-of-bounds reads.
